scope: Automatically reprice the actual bounded HotQueue on checked advisory model/content changes, retain newer full pending snapshots and stable waiting fairness, and vectorize rare-runner ranking without relaxing trading gates. Operational runtime, providers, wallets, orders, training and model/policy promotion remain OFF.

findings.evidence: Native queue chooses the old winner after an approved temporary ranking model is replaced; an invalidated artifact leaves its old stored bonus. This also reproduces with unchanged model/metadata byte sizes and mtimes.
findings.repair: Own one fresh family inference scope at admission/pop. Compare checked selector/model/metadata content provenance, rebuild pending priorities together on a generation change, and make unavailable or disabled ranking neutral. A mid-prediction replacement belongs to the next queue operation, never a mixed-head observation.

findings.evidence: An unchanged market bucket suppresses a new model generation for thirty minutes after evaluation, and a pending holders update is discarded.
findings.repair: Include checked evaluated generation and non-bucket learned inputs in bounded reconsideration. Preserve the original 15-second evaluation cooldown and unchanged-snapshot dedup TTL. Retain exact full pending snapshots even when market movement buckets do not change.

findings.evidence: A pending same-score update loses its original waiting turn; an old measured-age bonus can outrank a genuinely fresher candidate.
findings.repair: Retain the original waiting sequence and original enqueue/measurement clocks; advance deterministic measured age without fabricating birth from queue residence. Refresh at every actual pop, at most one second apart during admission bursts, and immediately for a new generation.

findings.evidence: Initial one-by-one 1000-candidate repricing takes16.620603s with one synthetic accepted head. The first batched attempt still takes15.780181s with nine heads because it repeatedly prepares one-row frames and transient entry telemetry.
findings.repair: Prepare a vectorized checked frame per head, retain independent invalid-row semantics, exact output-shape checks and row-aligned percentile results, and reuse same-generation snapshot predictions. Queue-owned scheduling scopes retain candidate advisory receipts rather than ephemeral entry observations; ordinary entry telemetry remains enabled and isolated. Final nine-head workload reprices998 pending snapshots in0.813362s.

priority_contract.generation: SHA256 of enabled state and detached checked runner family selection, including manifest/model/metadata hashes, validation availability and stable capture. Content is read afresh; same-mtime/same-size replacements cannot borrow an old identity. This does not attest executed Python or provider inputs.
priority_contract.meaning: Rank percentiles, not event probabilities or buy permission. Existing missing/corrupt models remain neutral; source, risk, route, liquidity, impact, amount, loss, confirmation and exit guards are unchanged.
priority_contract.snapshot_reuse: A learned bonus belongs to the same checked generation and unchanged feed snapshot. It is snapshot-based advisory evidence, not a newly measured market snapshot or continuously re-predicted age model. New snapshots and new generations recompute it; deterministic age priority advances separately.
priority_contract.batch_bound: At most1000 snapshots per vectorized chunk, with one family scope across all chunks and targets. Queue capacity, evaluation item limits and existing just-in-time scheduler budget remain unchanged. Refresh is synchronous local work, not a production latency SLA.
priority_contract.age_and_fairness: Model-only refresh does not reenqueue, reset dedup/evaluation clocks, increase waiting lifetime or count as evaluation. Updates keep their original waiting tie sequence. Original unknown birth age remains unknown; forged internal clocks, cached bonus and generation are discarded at admission. Nested feed snapshots are detached.
priority_contract.telemetry: Only explicit standalone scheduling scopes opt out of ephemeral entry query observations. Each queued token retains its learned rank/model selection and generation, with one aggregate generation-change event and snapshot refresh counters. Default, parent and ordinary nested entry scopes keep existing per-query provenance; batching also records original per-row query evidence in an entry scope.
priority_contract.failure_isolation: Nonfinite output is unknown per row; wrong output shape makes the head unknown, never silently truncates or broadcasts. Unproved semantic rows cannot disable valid peers. Model/policy activation and profitability approval are not implemented by queue ordering.
